Piaski New Jewish Cemetery

Jewish Cemetery · Piaski, Poland

Not demolished. This is the newer of Piaski's two Jewish cemeteries, a companion record to the town's separately documented Old cemetery elsewhere in this collection. No historical narrative survives specifically for this site, and its present condition reflects sustained disregard: a fireplace has been built from one matzevah, another serves as a bench, chickens are kept on the grounds by nearby residents, and remnants of a treehouse were found elsewhere on the site. A wooden matzevah placed by the Zapomniane ('Forgotten') foundation in 2017 to mark a grave has since gone missing, possibly destroyed; a monument to the Holocaust's Jewish victims also stands on the grounds.
